script-looking message rendered as plain text in BOTH paths

plan.commit_message:
Add customization page for both cookie-rendering hooks

/custom overrides the layout container with a manually written div
owning a <template> target (icon + data-toast-message slot, custom
CSS) and a checkbox-toggled listener that cancels :append to render
through a console-style notifier. Both paths stay XSS-inert.
plan.pr_title: US-006 - Customization page: template hook + event hook

results.review_findings: orchestrator browser pass found 2 real issues, fixed inline: (1) data-turbo=false form reset the checkbox before cookie consumption -> form left Turbo-driven + section made data-turbo-permanent; (2) lifecycle-bound :append listener missed the event during Turbo permanent swap -> module-level document listener (README pattern) with explanatory comment
